strings.name: Gita Gopinath
strings.summary: Gita Gopinath is an Indian-born American economist studying international finance, exchange rates and the dollar’s role in global trade. Trained in India and the United States, she taught at Chicago and Harvard before becoming the IMF’s first female chief economist in 2019. She became first deputy managing director in 2022, working on crisis responses and policy coordination, and returned to Harvard in 2025.

strings.highlights.h1.title: International finance research
strings.highlights.h1.text: Studies dollar dominance, exchange rates and trade, and monetary and financial policy in open economies.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Scholarship and policy
strings.highlights.h2.text: Led economic outlook work as IMF chief economist, then served as first deputy managing director.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Returned to Harvard
strings.timeline.t1.text: Ended her IMF first deputy managing director term in August and returned to Harvard Economics in the fall.
strings.timeline.t2.title: First deputy managing director
strings.timeline.t2.text: Moved from chief economist to first deputy managing director, overseeing surveillance and major IMF programs.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Pandemic policy proposal
strings.timeline.t3.text: Co-authored a pandemic policy paper proposing vaccination targets and international cooperation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: IMF chief economist
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became the IMF’s first female chief economist and led its World Economic Outlook work.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Joined Harvard
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved from teaching at Chicago to research and teaching in Harvard’s economics department.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Doctorate and first faculty post
strings.timeline.t6.text: Earned a Princeton economics PhD and began teaching at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Undergraduate education
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed undergraduate studies at Lady Shri Ram College, Delhi, before graduate study in Delhi and Washington.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in India
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Kolkata and raised in India before pursuing doctoral training and an academic career in the United States.
